title: O dia do apagão
grammar: Revisão: passado contínuo, when, while, because e so
goal: Conte uma noite sem luz usando passado contínuo junto com passado simples, while, because e so.
reading: There was a blackout in Lia’s street on Tuesday.
Houve um apagão na rua da Lia na terça.
She was cooking dinner when the power went out.
Ela preparava o jantar quando a energia acabou.
A soft glow came from an old petrol lamp.
Um brilho suave vinha de uma velha lamparina a gasolina.
Her brother was telling a riddle while she cooked.
O irmão dela contava uma charada enquanto ela cozinhava.
They were not worried; the darkness was almost fun.
Eles não estavam preocupados; a escuridão era quase divertida.
dialogue: What were you doing when the power went out?
O que você fazia quando a energia acabou?
I was cooking dinner. It was suddenly dark.
Eu cozinhava o jantar. De repente, ficou escuro.
No, he wasn’t. He was telling a riddle.
How long did you wait for the power?
Quanto tempo vocês esperaram a energia?
We waited two hours because the blackout was big.
Esperamos duas horas porque o apagão foi grande.
Did you eat in the dark?
Yes, we did. We ate by the glow of the lamp.
Sim. Comemos à luz da lamparina.
pron: Em blackout, a força cai em BLACK: BLÉC-aut. Em power, o som é quase uma sílaba só: “páuer”.
gram: She ___ dinner when the power went out.
Ela preparava o jantar quando a energia acabou.
A ação longa vai no contínuo, e a interrupção, no passado simples.
story: A noite sem luz de Lia
There was a blackout in Lia’s street on Tuesday evening.
Houve um apagão na rua da Lia na terça à noite.
She was cooking soup when the power suddenly went out.
Ela fazia sopa quando a energia acabou de repente.
The darkness was total, so she asked her brother for help.
A escuridão era total, então ela pediu ajuda ao irmão.
He was telling a riddle, but his phone had no battery.
Ele contava uma charada, mas o celular estava sem bateria.
While they looked for a lamp, someone knocked on the door.
Enquanto procuravam uma lamparina, alguém bateu à porta.
It was a neighbor, and she was holding an old petrol lamp.
Era uma vizinha, e ela segurava uma velha lamparina a gasolina.
A warm glow filled the kitchen, and they did not worry.
Um brilho quente encheu a cozinha, e eles não se preocuparam.
Then they sat outside and talked while the soup was cooling.
Depois sentaram lá fora e conversaram enquanto a sopa esfriava.
At eleven, the lights came back, and everybody cheered loudly.
Às onze, a luz voltou, e todos comemoraram bem alto.
Lia was tired, so she washed the pot and went to bed.
Lia estava cansada, então lavou a panela e foi dormir.
